answer: An admission auction stops bulk fakes. Each epoch sells only 500 entry slots: newcomers bid POA, top bids win, and winning bids are burned. A violet stamp marks each winning bid and the sable ledger lists every winner, so no operator can hide a thousand bids. Buying 1,000 slots at 20 POA each costs 20,000 POA against about 12,000 POA of rewards, a clear loss. An honest agent pays one bid, keeps its full share, and joins a market scarce as jade.
